title: The row auditor
prompt:
Given a list of number rows, count the rows whose **largest value is strictly greater than the sum of all its other values**. Implement `process(java.util.ArrayList<int[]> rows)` (0 for an empty list).

Example: rows `{9,1,2}` (9 > 3 ✓), `{3,3,3}` (3 > 6 ✗), `{1,1,5}` (5 > 2 ✓) → `2`.

tests.name: dominant row count
tests.hint: Per row: one pass for max and total, then compare max > total - max. Reset both between rows.
